text:
kai (Recruiting Ops): Heads-up: just finished a quick QA of today's vendor CSV import and found ~12 panels created without a scorecard attached. Example: panel P-3321 for CAN-912 opens to an empty form.
maya (People Ops): that's bad. Any pattern on the rows?
ats-import-bot: import job id=job-8031 source=vendor-Q rows=480 warnings=12
ats-import-bot: sample row (sanitized): {"candidate_id":"CAN-912","panel_id":"P-3321","rubric":"Senior SWE - v2" }
eli (Eng - Integrations): looks like vendor switched from sending `rubric_id` (canonical slug) to a free-text `rubric` column. Our importer expects `rubric_id` and treats unknown/alias fields as null, resulting in panels created with no template.
kai (Recruiting Ops): interviewers keep clicking the link and getting an empty scorecard. We missed feedback for one onsite already.
eli (Eng - Integrations): immediate fix: patch importer to accept `rubric` as an alias and map free-text to existing slugs using exact-match only. I will disable fuzzy fallback so we don't attach wrong rubrics. Deploying hotfix now.
scorecard-service-bot: queued job mark-blank-panels (job id mark-990) will flag affected panels as "needs review" and notify owners.
maya (People Ops): please also add a reject-on-missing-template rule for vendor imports so rows with unknown rubric are failed rather than creating empty panels. We can surface failed rows back to vendor for correction.
eli (Eng - Integrations): agreed. Plan: (1) hotfix to accept `rubric` alias and require exact slug mapping (deploy hotfix-720) (2) add import validation to fail rows with unknown rubric (3) run backfill to reprocess the 12 affected rows after vendor provides corrected slugs. ETA for hotfix: 45m.
kai (Recruiting Ops): adding a quick checklist item to hiring-ops: "verify rubric/rubric_id header with vendor before run". Also will reach out to affected interviewers to collect feedback manually.
eli (Eng - Integrations): hotfix-720 deployed at 2026-05-02T10:28:40Z. mark-990 flagged 12 panels and notifications sent to hiring owners.
maya (People Ops): closing loop for now. If anyone sees more blank scorecards after backfill, please reopen. :white_check_mark:
